description: Provides the OpenTelemetry Java API for creating and interacting with telemetry such as traces, metrics, baggage, and context propagation in instrumentation code. It defines the core interfaces and data types used to record telemetry without including an SDK implementation.

skipped-versions.reason: Published jar for io.opentelemetry:opentelemetry-api:1.34.0 ships a resource configuration (a 'resources' object) under the name META-INF/native-image/io.opentelemetry/opentelemetry-api/reflect-config.json, so every native-image build with it on the classpath fails with 'first level of document must be an array of class descriptors'; fixed upstream in 1.34.1, which renames the file to resource-config.json.
